# Monitor 2: Ongoing Assessments (M-2)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|

| Phases | Operations and Support (PH-OS) (primary), Production and Deployment (PH-PD) |
| Depends on | Monitor 1: System and Environment Changes (M-1), Select 5: Continuous Monitoring Strategy—System (S-5) |
| Inputs | Continuous monitoring strategy (ART-CONMON), System Security Plan (ART-SSP), Security assessment plan (ART-SAP), Security assessment report (ART-SAR), Plan of action and milestones (ART-POAM), Cybersecurity service agreements (ART-SVCA), Continuous monitoring data (EXT-MONITORING), Organizational risk context (ART-ORG-CONTEXT), System risk assessment (ART-RA), Developmental and operational test results (EXT-TEST-RESULTS) |

Purpose: Assess implemented and inherited controls on the frequencies of the continuous monitoring strategy, with reviews of the system at least annually.
<!-- END rmf:header -->
<!-- rmf:body authored -->

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** M-1 is done for this monitoring cycle and S-5 wrote
   `artifacts/data/conmon.yaml`. Monitoring data for the cycle is in the product directory
   (EXT-MONITORING). Why: ongoing assessments follow the frequencies of the monitoring
   strategy (SP 800-37r2 Task M-2) and assess the data it collects.
2. **Adopt the assessor's stance.** You act as PER-SCA, with the independence the AO
   required (A-1). Read `personas/PER-SCA.md` `## Role-play guidance`.
3. **Pick what is due.** From `conmon.yaml#frequencies`, the families whose frequency makes
   them due in this cycle (by date: the run's date, `uv run rmf run clock show`, against the
   last assessment in the journal; `continuous`, `daily`, `weekly` and `monthly` families are always due,
   `event-driven` families when the monitoring data or the journal records a triggering
   event). Add the controls with open POA&M items whose milestone fell due. Write the list in your first
   CHECKPOINT note. When more than 3 families are due, M-2 runs as several sessions: each
   takes at most 3 families, and the families carried are listed in ART-SAP (step 6) for the
   next session to take first. Why: assessing everything every cycle is neither required nor
   affordable; the strategy says what is assessed when (SP 800-137 §3.4).
4. **Assess family by family** with `_shared/assessment-batching.md` (M-2 variant), at
   most 3 families per session:
   1. Reuse first: results from the monitoring data (scans, configuration compliance,
      event data) and earlier determinations that are still current count as evidence when
      the assessor had the required independence (SP 800-37r2 Task M-2 discussion).
   2. Interview PER-ISSO (operations evidence), PER-CSSP (monitoring and incident data) and
      PER-CCP (inherited parts) for what the data does not show.
   3. Rewrite `artifacts/sar/results/<fam>.yaml` whole: for each control assessed, update
      the determination (`result`, `methods`, `summary` starting
      `M-2 <cycle date>:` (the run's date) and naming the evidence, `sources`); keep the determinations of
      controls not due unchanged. A new weakness gets a new finding (`FND-###`, numbered
      after the highest on disk) with `status: open`, `raised_at: M-2`, a severity and a
      recommendation, and its `triage` from PER-PM before M-2 ends (ASMT-006): the triage
      is the system owner's decision, so interview PER-PM for it. A rescan that changes a
      STIG result updates `artifacts/data/stig-summary.yaml` (whole) and appends `M-2` to
      ART-STIG `touched_by`. A
      finding the data shows fixed is closed only on evidence; keep its description.
   4. Judge effectiveness as well as compliance, as `conmon.yaml#monitoring` says: for each
      risk response in `artifacts/data/rar.yaml` touching the family, state in the summary
      whether the response lowered the risk to the level it aimed at, not only whether the
      control is in place. Use the metrics of `conmon.yaml#metrics` that name `M-2`, and the
      tools of `conmon.yaml#tools`, checking that each tool still runs as its `upkeep` says.
      Why: compliance and effectiveness monitoring answer different questions (SP 800-39
      §3.4), and unvalidated automation reports what it was set to report.
   5. Identify vulnerabilities as `conmon.yaml#vulnerability_management.identification`
      says: scans run with NIST SP 800-115 as their reference, automated before manual, the
      CVE list for publicly known vulnerabilities, and previous incident reports and logs
      cross-referenced with CVE, `ART-RA` and vendor bulletins (DoDI 8531.01 3.2). Compare
      the cycle's scan with the last one for each fix completed since, and keep watching a
      remediated component for codependent vulnerabilities (DoDI 8531.01 3.6). List each
      vulnerability found, with its discovery date and the scans that show it, in the
      CHECKPOINT: M-3 writes its analysis record (`vulnerabilities` of
      `artifacts/poam/items.yaml`, VULN-004) and its verification (VULN-005).
   6. `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --family <fam>`.
   7. CHECKPOINT for the family.
5. **Adjust the strategy where the results say so.** If an assessment shows a family needs
   a different frequency (repeated weaknesses: more often; a stable automated control:
   less often), or a new event trigger, interview PER-ISSM and PER-PM, then rewrite
   `artifacts/data/conmon.yaml` whole with the change. In `artifacts/ART-CONMON.md` append
   `M-2` to `touched_by` and append (or extend) `## Changes after ongoing assessment` with
   each change and its reason. If nothing changes, still append `M-2` to `touched_by` and
   record in that section that the frequencies held, with the evidence. Why: M-2
   lists ART-CONMON as an output, so it is done only when ART-CONMON lists M-2.
   Each cycle also appends to `conmon.yaml#measurement.results`: one result per measure due,
   `within_parameters` as the measure's `acceptable` limits say, and `informed` holding the
   measure's users (MMEAS-001). Why: a value outside its limits is the signal the strategy is
   there to catch.
6. **Update `artifacts/ART-SAP.md` and `artifacts/ART-SAR.md`.** In ART-SAP, append `M-2`
   to `touched_by` (once) and add `## Ongoing assessment plan (M-2)`: the scope assessed this
   session, the families carried to the next, and the evidence limits. In ART-SAR, append
   `M-2` to `touched_by` (once, the first cycle) and add a
   `## Ongoing assessment <cycle date> (M-2)` section: families assessed, result mix,
   new and closed findings by ID, and the reused evidence. Keep earlier sections: the SAR
   is an evolving document (SP 800-37r2 Task A-4 discussion).
7. **Measure the providers.** For each service due, append an `effectiveness` record to the
   agreement in `artifacts/data/service-agreements.yaml`, rewriting the file whole, and add `M-2`
   to the `touched_by` of `artifacts/ART-SVCA.md`. The owner's side measures (never the provider),
   against a service of the agreement. An `ineffective` rating raises an issue; one the parties
   cannot resolve is reported to PER-CIO, who resolves it (SVCA-002). Why: DoDI 8530.01 leaves the
   system owner accountable for the service it buys.
8. **Leave the POA&M alone.** New open findings get POA&M items at M-3 (Ongoing Risk
   Response), which owns `artifacts/poam/items.yaml` in Monitor; SAR-POAM-001 reports them
   against the POA&M until then. Why: M-2 assesses, M-3 responds.
9. **Build and check the task.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then
   `uv run rmf check <run> --task M-2`, until 0 errors.
10. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT for the task.

## Interviews

| Persona | Why | Question focus |
|---|---|---|
| PER-ISSO | consulted (C); operates the controls | records since the last assessment: account reviews, log reviews, patch and configuration status |
| PER-CSSP | consulted (C); monitoring and incident data | scan and event results, incidents in the cycle and their handling |
| PER-CCP | consulted (C); inherited parts | evidence the provider's part still operates as authorized |
| PER-ISSM | consulted (C) | frequency changes the results justify, new event triggers |
| PER-PM | consulted (C); system owner | system changes in the cycle that affect what is due; the triage of each new finding (ASMT-006) |

At least 1 interview with `task: M-2`. The agent acts as PER-SCA (responsible and
accountable); the SCA is the interviewer, not a respondent.

## Inputs

- `artifacts/ART-CONMON.md`, `artifacts/data/conmon.yaml` (frequencies, triggers)
- `artifacts/ART-SAR.md`, `artifacts/sar/results/<fam>.yaml` (earlier determinations and
  findings; only the families due)
- `artifacts/ART-SSP.md`, `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml` (only the families due)
- `artifacts/ART-SAP.md`, `artifacts/data/sap.yaml` (methods per control)
- `artifacts/ART-POAM.md`, `artifacts/poam/items.yaml` (items whose milestones fell due)
- Monitoring data (EXT-MONITORING): the product directory, for example
  `product/monitoring/`; cite it as `product/<path>#<anchor>`
- Assessment objectives: `uv run rmf catalog show --family <fam> --run <run> --fields title,objectives`

## Outputs

`artifacts/data/service-agreements.yaml` (schema `service-agreements`) and `artifacts/ART-SVCA.md` change in step 7.

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/sar/results/<fam>.yaml` | — | families assessed this cycle, each written whole |
| `artifacts/ART-SAR.md` | append `M-2` to `touched_by` | updated (updater) |
| `artifacts/data/conmon.yaml` | — | rewritten whole only when a frequency or trigger changes |
| `artifacts/ART-CONMON.md` | append `M-2` to `touched_by` | updated (updater) |

## Facts

M-2 writes no facts.

## Done when

- Every family due this cycle has updated determinations, with new weaknesses as open
  findings that have a severity and recommendation.
- ART-SAR and ART-CONMON list M-2 in `touched_by`, with this cycle's sections.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task M-2` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- One CHECKPOINT per family: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task M-2 · family: <fam>`.
- A final CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task M-2`, with the families assessed and
  the number of new and closed findings.
- A changed SSP statement is not M-2's to make: journal a NOTE for M-4 (Authorization
  Updates), which updates the security plan from monitoring results.
